results.action_definition: Forecast future values based on historical time-series patterns and features

conditions.name: temporal_column_required
conditions.description: Table must have at least one temporal column (DATE/TIMESTAMP)
conditions.rationale: Time-series forecasting requires a temporal dimension to establish sequence and trends
conditions.evaluable_as: Check if any column has is_temporal=true in data_schema

conditions.name: numerical_metric_required
conditions.description: Table must have at least one numerical column (the metric to forecast)
conditions.rationale: Forecasting requires a quantitative metric (e.g., event counts, severity scores) to predict future values
conditions.evaluable_as: Check if any column has is_numerical=true in data_schema

conditions.name: features_for_prediction
conditions.description: Table should ideally have at least 2 additional columns (categorical/numerical) beyond temporal + metric
conditions.rationale: Multiple feature dimensions improve forecast accuracy by capturing contextual factors (e.g., region, age group, symptom type)
conditions.evaluable_as: Count columns where (is_categorical=true OR is_numerical=true) AND NOT is_temporal

conditions.name: sufficient_data_volume
conditions.description: Table must have at least 100 records for statistical validity of time-series patterns
conditions.rationale: Forecasting requires sufficient historical data to identify trends; <100 records insufficient for reliable pattern detection

results.action_definition: Identify and quantify differences in outcomes across multiple groups or time periods

conditions.name: grouping_dimensions_required
conditions.description: Table must have at least 2 categorical columns (to define groups for comparison)
conditions.rationale: Meaningful comparison requires multiple dimensions (e.g., region AND vaccine type, or age group AND symptom type) to segment data

conditions.name: metric_to_compare
conditions.description: Table must have at least 1 numerical column (the metric to measure differences)
conditions.rationale: Comparison requires a quantifiable outcome metric (e.g., severity, event count, rate) to measure differences across groups
conditions.evaluable_as: Check if any column has is_numerical=true in data_schema

conditions.name: adequate_data_volume
conditions.description: Table must have at least 1000 records for valid statistical comparison across groups
conditions.rationale: Group comparisons require sufficient data per group; <1000 total records risks underpowered statistical tests and unreliable conclusions

results.action_definition: Identify statistical or logical associations between two or more variables

conditions.name: multiple_numerical_variables
conditions.description: Table must have at least 2 numerical columns
conditions.rationale: Correlation analysis requires at least 2 quantitative variables to measure association between them

conditions.name: sufficient_sample_size
conditions.description: Table must have at least 50 records for correlation validity
conditions.rationale: Correlation estimates are unstable with small samples; <50 records produces unreliable confidence intervals

results.action_definition: Create summaries, aggregates, and statistical overviews from data

conditions.name: aggregatable_content
conditions.description: Table must have at least 1 column suitable for aggregation (numerical or categorical)
conditions.rationale: Summarization requires content to aggregate; tables with only ID columns or single values cannot produce meaningful summaries
conditions.evaluable_as: Check if len(numerical_columns) + len(categorical_columns) >= 1 in data_schema

conditions.name: grouping_optional_but_enhances
conditions.description: Table ideally has at least 1 categorical column (optional but enables grouped summaries)
conditions.rationale: Categorical columns enable segmented summaries (e.g., 'summary by region'), providing richer insights than single aggregate

results.action_definition: Extract rows or records matching specific criteria or conditions

conditions.name: filterable_columns_exist
conditions.description: Table must have at least 1 column (any type) to filter on
conditions.rationale: Filtering requires columns with values to match against; tables without columns cannot be filtered

results.action_definition: Link tables on common keys to create enriched dataset

conditions.name: has_join_key
conditions.description: Table must have at least one column that can serve as join key (typically primary or foreign key)
conditions.rationale: Joining requires matching columns between tables; without join keys, cannot establish relationships

results.action_definition: Find causal or mechanistic explanations for observed phenomena

conditions.name: outcome_to_explain
conditions.description: Table must have at least 1 numerical column (the outcome phenomenon to explain)
conditions.rationale: Explanation requires an outcome variable to analyze; without a measurable outcome, cannot determine causes
conditions.evaluable_as: Check if any column has is_numerical=true in data_schema

conditions.name: explanatory_features
conditions.description: Table must have at least 3 additional columns (categorical or numerical) as potential explanatory features
conditions.rationale: Causal explanation requires multiple feature dimensions to identify drivers; <3 features insufficient to isolate causation
conditions.evaluable_as: Count columns where (is_categorical=true OR is_numerical=true) AND is not the outcome

conditions.rationale: Correlation estimates are unstable with small samples; <50 records produces unreliable confidence intervals
